ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import lowerKeys from modules::util output application/json --- lowerKeys(payload)

db:update.db:sql: UPDATE alert_event SET status = 'acknowledged', updated_at = :now WHERE id = :id AND status = 'open'
db:update.db:input-parameters: #[%dw 2.0 import nowIso from modules::util --- { id: vars.alertId, now: nowIso() }]

db:update.db:sql: UPDATE alert_event SET status = 'resolved', resolved_at = :now, updated_at = :now WHERE id = :id AND status <> 'resolved'
db:update.db:input-parameters: #[%dw 2.0 import nowIso from modules::util --- { id: vars.alertId, now: nowIso() }]

raise-error.description: #['Unknown action ' ++ vars.alertAction ++ '; use acknowledge or resolve']
#['Alert ' ++ vars.alertId ++ ' not found or already ' ++ vars.alertAction ++ 'd']

set-payload.value: #[output application/json --- {id: vars.alertId, action: vars.alertAction, ok: true}]

db:select.db:sql: SELECT org_id, name, parent_id, collected_at FROM inventory_business_group ORDER BY name
SELECT env_id, org_id, name, env_type, is_production FROM inventory_environment ORDER BY name
SELECT app_id, name, org_id, env_id, status, runtime_version FROM inventory_application ORDER BY name
SELECT api_id, asset_id, version, label, org_id, env_id, status FROM inventory_api ORDER BY asset_id

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import lowerKeys from modules::util output application/json var bgs = lowerKeys(vars.bgs) var envs = lowerKeys(vars.envs) var orgName = (id) -> (bgs filter ((b) -> b.org_id == id))[0].name default id var envName = (id) -> (envs filter ((e) -> e.env_id == id))[0].name default id --- { collectedAt: bgs[0].collected_at, businessGroups: bgs map ((b) -> b ++ { parent: if (b.parent_id != null) orgName(b.parent_id) else null }), environments: envs map ((e) -> e ++ { org: orgName(e.org_id) }), applications: lowerKeys(vars.apps) map ((a) -> a ++ { org: orgName(a.org_id), env: envName(a.env_id) }), apis: lowerKeys(vars.apis) map ((a) -> a ++ { org: orgName(a.org_id), env: envName(a.env_id) }) }

db:select.db:sql: SELECT id, job_name, trigger_src, status, started_at, finished_at, message FROM job_run ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import lowerKeys from modules::util output application/json --- { runs: lowerKeys(payload), intervalMinutes: p('scheduler.collectAll.frequencyMinutes') as Number }

raise-error.description: #['Unknown job ' ++ vars.jobName ++ '; use collect_all, collect_audit, collect_usage or collect_inventory']

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var editable = ["alerts.email.to", "audit.exclude_actions", "audit.auto_resolve_days", "audit.max_lookback_hours"] --- (payload pluck ((v, k) -> { setting_key: k as String, setting_value: write(v, "application/json", {indent: false}) })) filter ((s) -> editable contains s.setting_key)

raise-error.description: No editable settings in request body
